boundary: This policy validates dependency license expressions recorded in package-lock.json and the reviewed exception list for current dependencies.
It does not provide legal advice, prove upstream license text completeness, or replace release attribution review.
Unexpected, missing, denied, or overdue reviewed-exception licenses fail closed until reviewed.

reviewedLicenseExceptions.reason: Optional platform libvips binary packages pulled by sharp. Review obligation is to preserve package distribution metadata and reassess when sharp/libvips versions change.
Optional Windows sharp binary packages with libvips linkage. Review obligation is to preserve package distribution metadata and reassess when sharp/libvips versions change.
Optional sharp WebAssembly binary package with mixed permissive/LGPL terms. Review obligation is to preserve package distribution metadata and reassess when sharp/libvips versions change.

updateTriggers: A dependency license expression is added, removed, or changes.
A reviewed license exception reaches its next-review date.
Release artifact paths, NOTICE, SBOM, or dependency policy changes.
Legal guidance changes the accepted or denied license posture.
